# Alpha 43 — Focus home and mobile workspace navigation

- Replace large Home launch panels with a prominent Continue card, New/Open actions and compact workspace shortcuts.
- Add top-left file browser menus to Files and Documents on iPhone. Keep the browser and document in equal halves in wide Duo/tablet windows.
- Add paired text/Markdown editors: choose another open document with Split, switch the left pane to browsing, and retain both drafts when the window narrows.
- Give LM Chat a conversation menu, with conversation history on the left and messages on the right in wide windows. Preserve each conversation's unsent draft. Chat, its configuration and Settings use full-screen destinations.
- Include the mobile library catalog, cover preference, folder/transfer presentation and confirmation improvements developed alongside this update.
- Extend native screen checks for drawers, independent editor panes, conversation history and configuration navigation; allow the Apple system logger to drain the test report before exit.

Local validation includes 161 mobile UI/tooling tests and 46 mobile core tests (three native-bridge cases skipped on the host), plus lint checks. The source-release workflow validates desktop platforms and native Android/iOS builds and runtimes before publishing the archive. Native Duo fold gestures and physical touch/accessibility checks remain separate from those automated gates.
